svg.aria-label: Adib Alqurashi. Data science student at KFUPM · Dammam, Saudi Arabia. “I have limits. What I create will go beyond them.” Abstract: I'm drawn to research and mathematics, and I like turning what I learn into things people actually use. I keep everything I learn, written down and connected, because ideas grow when they are kept. And I love to contribute: the best way I know to understand something is to build it with other people. I'm a third-year data science student at KFUPM, heading for a career in academic research.
